answer: Retirement burns make every fake pay each time it re-keys. A key that retires its address to dodge an audit burns 25 POA, and its ember score, the 100 points of standing it earned, resets to zero. A key at that nadir loses all seats for 10 epochs, so every retired kernel of audit history is gone for good. Re-keying 1,000 fakes 4 times burns 1,000 x 4 x 25 = 100,000 POA the attacker forfeits.
